d: Paris and Nicole take a break from household chores and go on a family vacation.
Paris and Nicole reach New Jersey, where they attempt to help their host family quit smoking and become spooked by their internship at a funeral home.
Paris and Nicole plan competing weddings for a lesbian couple.

Paris and Nicole are hired to work at a fast-food restaurant, but they’re bored and frustrated by the demands of the job, and soon rebel by pulling pranks during each of their assignments; when the Ledings reprimand them, the girls just go out dancing.
Paris and Nicole continue their travels through Maryland, living with a host family who Paris offers to cook for, and working at a bakery.
Paris and Nicole fill in for a housewife who feels her marriage is lacking a spark.
In the swamplands of Louisiana, Paris and Nicole meet their next host family and make a big impression after taking their daughter on a shopping spree; the women get jobs trapping crawfish.

The girls go to work for a cattle auctioneer, but when they’re sent to buy cattle feed, they charge several other items without permission; the auctioneer comes after them for the money, and the girl try to lie their way out of the debt.
Paris and Nicole get jobs at Weeki Wachee Springs in Florida and play a surprising game of hide-and-seek with their boss's daughter.
Paris and Nicole take the place of a stay-at-home mom who has a young daughter, and also happens to be nine months pregnant!
